caption: The drawing depicts a single brass bell mounted on a textured, rusted, brownish rectangular wall bracket. The bell itself is golden-yellow with subtle brown shading, and it features a smoothly curved lip and a rounded top. A U-shaped metal arm extends from the bracket to the top of the bell, securing it in place. Attached to the underside of the bell is a clapper, rendered with a slightly darker brown and bronze tone, ending in a rounded drop. The background is an off-white or light beige color, with no additional objects or details present, creating an uncluttered and isolated composition. There is a small handwritten name, "Edith Emerson," near the lower right corner.
title: Bell, from Presidential Yacht "Sylph"
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
